Jordan (Seaborn): Hey @Redwood-CS — Seaborn here. We're planning to onboard a custom Scribe v1 (13B) for clinical notes. Need PHI isolation, KMS/HSM, and eval plan. Is Private deployment + HSM supported for this model? Also concerned about tokenization differences with our preprocessing.
Maria (CS): Thanks Jordan! Short answers: yes we support Private + HSM. Can you share model artifact details (format/onnx/gguf) and sample prompt set? I'll start intake.
Jordan (Seaborn): Artifact is GGUF 13b float16, uses custom tokenizer (huggingface bytes_bpe) with small vocab changes. We'll provide sample prompt set (~500 examples) and regen scripts.
Elaine (Eng): Looping in infra/eng. For HSM we need key policy and certs. Also want to know max sequence length and expected qps. Any latency SLO?
Jordan (Seaborn): Seq len usually 1024 (avg 250), peak qps 15, SLO 95% < 200ms token latency if possible. Cost sensitivity — prefer quantization to int8 if accuracy ok.
Devon (DevEx): We can assist with quantization eval — recommend running our `quant-eval` harness. Can you share eval metrics target (EM/F1/answer-quality)?
Jordan (Seaborn): Priority: safety: no hallucinations on med advice. Need eval thresholds: 0.8 for accuracy on our clinical label set, and low hallucination rate (<2%).
Elaine (Eng): Got it. For Private + HSM next steps: 1) intake form, 2) share model artifact + tokenizer, 3) provide eval set + scoring script, 4) assign dedicated onboarding engineer. I'll assign someone after intake. Also provisioning ETA ~2w.
Maria (CS): Jordan I'll DM you intake form link. Also schedule a 30m kickoff this week? Friday morning UTC works?
Jordan (Seaborn): Friday 10:00 UTC works. Thanks all. Uploading artifacts to secure bucket now. Using s3 presign: `s3://seaborn-onboard-2026/13b/manifest.json`.
secure-upload-bot: Artifact upload detected for seaborn-onboard-2026 at s3://seaborn-onboard-2026/13b/manifest.json :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Great — I'll confirm when I see the files. :thumbsup:
